PORT.description: HTTP port the server listens on (Railway provides this automatically)

WOODPECKER_HOST.description: Public URL of this server (used for webhook callbacks and agent connections)

RAILWAY_RUN_UID.description: REQUIRED — run the container as root (uid 0). The woodpecker-server -alpine image runs as uid 1000, but Railway mounts the sqlite volume root-owned, so a non-root process cannot open it and crash-loops with 'unable to open database file'. Set to 0 so every fresh install boots.

WOODPECKER_ADMIN.description: Leave empty — first OAuth-registered user becomes admin. Set to your GitHub/Gitea/GitLab username to auto-grant admin on first login. (optional)

WOODPECKER_AGENT_SECRET.description: Shared secret for agent-to-server authentication (must match agent's secret)

WOODPECKER_GRPC_SECRET.description: Shared gRPC secret for agent communication

WOODPECKER_GITHUB.description: Enable the GitHub forge. Woodpecker v3 requires exactly one forge driver to be enabled or it will crash-loop on startup (forge not configured). Keep true and add WOODPECKER_GITHUB_CLIENT / WOODPECKER_GITHUB_SECRET for the login button to work. To use a different forge instead, set one of WOODPECKER_FORGEJO / WOODPECKER_GITEA / WOODPECKER_GITLAB to true — and this one to false.
